item.subject: science
item.stem:
During a monsoon storm over her school in Nagpur, Meera sees a bright flash of lightning and soon hears thunder. Inside the storm cloud, strong winds make water droplets and ice particles rub against each other.
Which sequence correctly describes how lightning and thunder are produced?

options.A: Rubbing separates charges; charge separation builds an imbalance; the built-up charge breaks down the insulating property of air; a sudden discharge gives lightning; rapid heating and expansion of air gives thunder.
options.B: Thunder heats the cloud first; the heat separates the charges; the charges then cancel each other quietly; the cloud collapses to give the lightning flash.
options.C: Two clouds physically collide; the collision directly produces the lightning flash; the flash then separates the charges; thunder comes from the clouds breaking apart.
options.D: Air first becomes a perfect conductor; charges flow slowly and silently; the silent flow produces thunder; thunder then ignites the lightning flash.
